finish.outcome: Found the cause: Sessions.js is_filler() (line 1726) does not screen the literal word 'undefined'/'null', so when the single voice assistant's nudged turn (single_cue's bare '(pause)') ended with that literal text as its only content - right after the pm4hrqsb tasks.add tool call with no accompanying reply text - heard() (Sessions.js:1565-1616) posted it verbatim as a chat bubble. The item tool itself is clean: run_item_now always returns a plain object, JSON.stringify'd before the model ever sees it (page_tools.js:1147-1439), so no 'undefined' is ever written there. Smallest fix (not applied, read-only brief): add a literal undefined/null check to is_filler(). Could not confirm via the browser (site.shot timed out on networkidle; no tab open for site.eval), so the finding rests on session.jsonl + code reading only. Full detail in the log lines above.
